# Startup Intelligence

> Startup Intelligence is an independent digital services initiative focused on custom website development, technical SEO and practical digital growth.

## Services
- Custom website planning and development
- Responsive interface and UX implementation
- Technical SEO foundations and content structure
- Performance and accessibility considerations
- Web application, backend, AI and automation requirements assessed as separate scopes

## Important facts
- Current minimum website project budget discussed: INR 5,000. This is a starting threshold, not a fixed package price.
- Final scope, exclusions, delivery milestones and commercial terms are confirmed in a written proposal.
- The public portfolio currently contains conceptual visuals, not verified client case studies.
- The enquiry form currently prepares an email draft. It does not submit data to a backend or reserve a meeting.
- Startup Intelligence is described as an independent initiative and is not represented as a registered company on this preview website.

This is a preview website. Pages use noindex directives and should not be treated as the canonical public production site. Production canonical URLs and indexing directives must be switched during production release.
